verificationMethod.scope: Official provider pages, official terms/reuse documents, official collection/help pages, and already-frozen repository governance only; no corpus payload fetched.

officialReferences.finding: Official open-data page offers plenary protocols and documents for machine processing and reports archive display sizes/counts, but its dynamically rendered index did not yield immutable exact archive URLs in this verification.
DIP terms permit comprehensive use/processing of API machine-readable data with source and change notices, while retaining third-party-rights responsibility and API access conditions.

Official help establishes predictable package identifiers and content URL structures; exact package size and controlling package-specific notices were not established for proposed packages without payload/package verification.

Individual publications can carry CC BY 4.0 reuse notices and language variants, but broad provider status is not source-level authority and exact file endpoints/sizes require a frozen publication allowlist.
